paragraphs: Nekosa. R' Yehudah ben Nekosa, a Tanna; Yoma 18a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: יח.. is rendered 18a, reading the doubled period as the folio-side marker and a terminal stop. The exact supplied punctuation remains in the Hebrew; no named edition is independently checked.
Nekosa is a conventional vocalization of נקוסא. Hyman’s Tanna classification and ben relationship are preserved; the abbreviated title remains R'.
